notes.title: Angelic Community Update: Biggest Expansion Ever, Campaign Updates Inside
notes.content: [p]The last few months have marked one of the most dramatic evolutions in Angelic’s history. We’ve revamped vast parts of the game and added a bazillion new features. These additions are altering the core systems and are crucial for the upcoming narrative campaigns, while also significantly improving our free-to-play multiplayer edition.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s a detailed look into the massive overhaul currently underway:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Cinematic Layers[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’ve added cinematic kill cams and brutal combat moments that hit like a freight train.[/p][p]New systems include:[/p][list][*][p]Kill cams with dramatic slow motion, camera shifts, special FX, and sequencers[/p][/*][*][p]Overkill animations with dismemberment and brutal deaths[/p][/*][*][p]Environmental interactions like knockbacks, wall collisions, and terrain hazards[/p][/*][*][p]Destructible elements like bridges, barrels, and structural weak points[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="cjoGklUG6DI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]Kill Cam Feature Showcase. Gameplay Capture. Viewer discretion advised![/i][/p][p][/p][p]These aren’t just visual flair, they improve readability. Thanks to our new cinematic system, even multi-target kills feel clear, satisfying, and brutal.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]MetaHuman Integration[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Since Angelic's 2020 build, we’ve been crafting cinematic experiences, but our characters always struggled to deliver the hyper-realistic facial expressions we were striving for. They usually looked solid but never quite [i]felt[/i] real enough. Until now...[/p][p][/p][p]Since mid-2023, we’ve been migrating our heroes to MetaHuman, Epic Games' cutting-edge character infrastructure for Unreal Engine. After years of intensive R&D, facial rig adjustments, custom shader tuning, and performance testing, this migration is now nearing completion.[/p][p][/p][p]MetaHuman enables the hyper-realistic facial expressions we need for our upcoming, emotion-heavy campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/e7a5c7a9d8a46f882fdcad638e7bfd33a348068a.png"][/img][i]We captured countless hilarious expressions, but space is limited, so we’ll only tease a few :) (Featuring Aurora)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Now, our characters finally feel real, breathing, reacting, and emoting with film-quality fidelity.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]New Heroes & Characters[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]The Angelic universe is expanding. Here are some of the characters now implemented or in active development:[/p][p]Xue & Chun, dark and light siblings. You’ve already met them, but never had the chance to play with them. They’re not coming alone. They bring their guardian: Shanwang, the Mountain King, a dragon-horse synth. Playing as Shanwang is something else entirely. Imagine controlling a giant winged synth, hearing his poetic, deep reactions. We can't wait.[/p][p][/p][p]Bart, the Vivibot. Your favorite sarcastic bot who still can't pronounce the letter “B” properly and loves dancing... ahem, also punching enemies into the sky.[/p][p][/p][p]Diana Lindberg, an enhanced (cybernetic) human, independent journalist, and media icon. With nearly 2 billion followers, she’s both a powerful symbol and a prime target for corporate assassins.[/p][p][/p][p]Sopdet, the Oracle of the Goddess. Diplomat, warrior, and luminous daughter of Iset. You’ve seen her concept art before.[/p][p][/p][p]Matriarch of the Nameless Ones, the ancient librarian and keeper of the Wall of Arch-Lore. Whatever you do, never look into her third eye.[/p][p][/p][p]Infested horrors, including the Niataju, a swarm horror capable of spreading infestation rapidly, and Marajuaronesis, a towering, regenerative abomination. Long-time followers may remember the early female version of this creature from our 2021 vertical slice. The new one is 100 times more terrifying.[/p][p][/p][p]Supreme Cartel Commandos, brutal eugenic supersoldiers. Hoshi Ryu kenshis and vanguards are also coming, including the infamous Bōrei, undead warriors cursed to never find peace. That’s all we can say for now, to avoid spoilers.[/p][p][/p][p]Ryoji Hoshinaga, a powerful Hoshi Ryu lieutenant who will play a key role in the upcoming campaign.[/p][p]Two major new characters, whose names we can’t reveal yet due to story spoilers, only identified for now s Z. and L. One of them will appear in the attached screenshot. They’re neo-humans, but with a twist.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/4ac9692b85541184d310a538c4e715ad66cdd89d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Meet L (name hidden to avoid spoilers). A major addition to the story. What you see here is a direct in-game capture.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Many more: infested humans, rogue synths, colony NPCs, mutant creatures, and yes, even the redesign of our divine goddess Iset. She will be magnificent.[/p][p][/p][p]We told you, this is the biggest expansion in Angelic’s history.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Combat System Overhaul[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We completely rewrote how abilities work under the hood.[/p][p][/p][p]Heroes now instantly react to your commands. You click, they respond. They now clearly show what they’re about to do whenever you select an ability. For example, select Rumbrogon's cleave, and he’ll visibly raise his weapon to show he’s about to strike. Previously, they wouldn’t react until the skill was executed.[/p][p][/p][p]To make this possible, we:[/p][list][*][p]Remade and polished hundreds of animations and re-implemented them[/p][/*][*][p]Re-aligned VFX and SFX for every ability[/p][/*][*][p]Tuned transitions, hit reactions, and targeting logic[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The result? A far more responsive, predictable, and fast gameplay loop.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also adding facial expressions to every single animation. We aim for perfection, and it doesn't matter if it's combat or cinematic. Our characters must look superb. Period.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Unique Hero Mechanics[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We're doubling down on what makes each hero feel truly distinct, not just in theme but in gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Seline can now fly across the map with full vertical control, evade melee attackers, and turbo through danger[/p][/*][*][p]Odile can glide over deadly zones and move at ultra-fast speeds mid-air (though she can’t gain much vertical elevation)[/p][/*][*][p]Phoenix and Xander now feature continuous-fire mechanics, hold down LMB to dynamically aim and sustain firepower[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]These mechanics introduce entirely new tactical dimensions. They required deep changes to traversal systems, camera logic, animations, passives, and even enemy AI. They also affected other abilities. For example, Seline's healing abilities have been migrated to a continuous variation, so she keeps healing while her allies are under attack. That makes our turn-based combat feel more multi-layered, sometimes almost real-time, with multiple heroes reacting simultaneously.[/p][p][/p][p]And more heroes are gaining signature mechanics. Chun can teleport enemies into cliffs, or lava pools. That means the battlefield is becoming even more interactive.[/p][p][/p][p]Pale Phantom can now enter Qatom Swarm Cloud mode. He disintegrates into millions of cubes and can pass through thin objects like a ghost or fly (kind of) and effectively become untargetable unless hit by an AoE ability.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Dynamic and Interactable Environments[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]You can now jump with your heroes. Obviously, with flying and gliding mechanics being implemented, we couldn’t leave other heroes without the basic ability of jumping.[/p][p][/p][p]But mind where you jump. Fall damage is now a thing, and heroes can weaponize it. If Chun teleports you to the edge of a cliff, falling might kill you. Or if someone destroys the bridge you’re standing on, your hero will fall, unless they can fly or glide.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hero Customizations[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We are revamping our customization and skin system. By using our customized version of Unreal's mutables, you will be able to personalize your heroes with a great degree of control. Want a different hair color for Aurora? Done. A new eye design for Chun? Sure. Change the color theme of Phoenix or swap wing designs on Seline? Go ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]Only one rule: you cannot alter the proportions or facial structures of the heroes. This preserves their identity and visual consistency, and ensures cinematics work as designed.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Physical Improvements and Procedural Animations[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We have significantly improved the ragdoll system and IK (inverse kinematics) for our characters, both heroes and NPCs. This was a much-needed upgrade to make their animations physically interactable, and their falls and deaths ultra-realistic. It will hugely complement our kill cameras too.[/p][p][/p][p]Even more, we are adding procedural animations to our heroes. Combined with their new fall, jump, hard stop, and hit animations, the procedural system makes them respond and react naturally to their environment.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]UI & UX Redesign[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re rebuilding the entire combat interface, along with the hero menu and game lobby.[/p][p][/p][p]Expect:[/p][list][*][p]Cleaner layouts[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer ability indicators[/p][/*][*][p]Faster navigation[/p][/*][*][p]More visual feedback[/p][/*][*][p]Sexier designs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We revamped how the combat log works and overhauled nearly every UI component in the game. Not just in combat, but also in the hero menu, the game lobby ([url="https://x.com/AngelicTheGame/status/1897667341309116773"]you may have seen the video[/url]), and even the main menu. Our new menu sub-levels feature signature hero poses and beautiful 3D backgrounds.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Visual Effects Revamp[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We’re upgrading every visual effect in the game. Everything, from Seline’s healing pulses to Phoenix’s rifle fire, has been redesigned. Odile’s gravity powers now ripple across the terrain, Chun’s portals look epic, and Shanwang’s mountain breeze might literally freeze you in awe.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/7af47abaff815f28c17831a0786b97594a1e0451.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i]Shanwang and Xue. What a majestic duo! Their combat abilities are just as impressive as their stories, looks, and personalities.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Narrative Mode Preparation[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Everything listed here, from MetaHuman upgrades to new abilities, lays the foundation for the single-player campaign.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The campaign has always been our dream. Everything we’ve built so far is leading to it.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’re developing rich, handcrafted environments, stunning cinematics, and a deep, unforgettable story brought to life by our multi-layered cast of heroes.[/p][p][/p][p]So far, we’ve only talked about the systems already built or in development. This milestone also includes hero progression mechanics (with tons of new abilities) and more features.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Note About the Future[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Once our current sprint is over, we will begin work on hero progression. This will be just as ambitious as what we’ve already shared.[/p][p][/p][p]We are adding approximately 10 new abilities per hero, plus more modifier abilities.[/p][p][/p][p]These won’t just be new skills, but entirely new categories of abilities. At the moment you’ve only seen basic abilities (usable during active turns), stance abilities (triggered during passive turns to make heroes react to events), and a few limited passive abilities (like Rumbrogon's disengagement attack).[/p][p][/p][p]Now we are adding Alterations, which significantly transform a hero’s kit by turning them into something else. For example, Daeva can become the Succubus, Odile becomes the White Swan, Seliné turns into the Dark Nightingale, and Aurora transforms into the Daughter of the Storm. These powerful skills unlock entirely new abilities or alter existing ones in dramatic ways.[/p][p][/p][p]We are also adding ability modifiers, indirect skills that impact your basic, stance, passive, and alteration abilities.[/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, we are introducing combo abilities, tag abilities (coordinate with an ally to unleash devastating attacks), and even infection abilities. Infection will now play a much deeper and more sophisticated role, so you’ll need to monitor your heroes’ infection levels carefully. Some heroes and units are immune, like already-infested heroes (Rumbrogon, Odile) or fully mechanical units.[/p][p][/p][p]This evolution of progression will push tactical depth in Angelic to an entirely new level.[/p][p][/p][p]This milestone, known internally as the Prime Vertical Slice, and officially titled Angelic: Dark Symphony Prelude - Dread Heaven, is without question the most ambitious development phase in our history. And it’s far from over. But each step brings us closer to making Angelic the strategy-RPG experience we all envisioned.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll share more gameplay videos, visuals, official soundtracks and screenshots in the coming months. Please bear with us. These features are massive, and our full focus is on delivering them.[/p][p][/p][p]If we’ve been quiet lately, it’s not because we’ve gone dark. It’s because we’ve been building like mad. We’ve expanded the team, sharpened our focus, and poured ourselves into something we believe in.[/p][p][/p][p]So please, don’t expect frequent updates. But when we do share something, expect it to be fantastic.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for staying with us on this ride.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Glory to Angelic 🪽[/b][/p]

notes.title: Up for a drink with Daeva, Aurora, and Xander? 🍷
notes.content: [p]In Angelic’s brutal universe, survival isn’t just a fight. It’s a cost paid in memories, and pain. The storms you face aren’t just outside... they rage inside you, too. So when a fleeting moment of peace arrives, you drink. You breathe. You remind yourself you’re still human (or neo-human). [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/6b896727ddbffd50811c886ce3961145064c6762.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Yet, peace is just an illusion.[/p][p]Aurora loathes Daeva. Xander? He mirrors Daeva’s posture without even realizing it. A platonic crush that only fuels the fire smoldering in his tormented soul. [/p][p][/p][p]And in all this darkness, there's Seliné. The blue angel. Pure empathy. Gentle grace... [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/fe8c4551c2b529dad627e29163662b28c4a742c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]A flicker of light in the void. She listens when others shout, heals where others wound. But never mistake her serenity for surrender. Seliné may be kind, but she is no stranger to power. Her mercy is a choice. Her wrath, a last resort. [/p][p][/p][p]-*- [/p][p][/p][p]Angelic is beautiful. [/p][p]Angelic is dreadful.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s pain and love. Ruin and glory. [/p][p]It’s drama. It’s a theatre.[/p][p][/p][p]A Theatre of Chaos.[/p][p][/p][p] -*-[/p][p][/p][p][b]We’ll be revealing epic new features soon.[/b] [/p][p]Stay close.[/p][p][/p][p] [b]Glory to Angelic![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/606cea1541964b8e5f1401968796d465ac36998e.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Wingblade J8, A Corpo Ship in a Neo-Human Colony?
notes.content:
𝗪𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗯𝗹𝗮𝗱𝗲 𝗝𝟴 - one of the most successful fighter jets, capable of combat in both space and atmospheric environments—belongs to Hoshi Ryu, a militaristic mega-corporation notorious for its aggressive expansion and deep ties to space pirates. 🏴‍☠️

[previewyoutube=tew27dz0Fk0;full][/previewyoutube]

Their hunger for domination knows no bounds, often leading them to capture and re-colonize long-abandoned neo-human settlements. 

Yet even they refuse to enter Dread Heaven, a forsaken colony where every explorer has vanished without a trace. 

So, what is one of their jets doing there? And why are our angels allowing it to land?

notes.title: Hail to the Revamped Angel Nest!
notes.content:
Immerse yourself in the haunting beauty of one of our most iconic maps, now reimagined and visually enhanced for the upcoming open alpha season 3(*) of Angelic: The Chaos Theatre.

[previewyoutube=8JsAMj5NXeE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]A bit of backstory:[/b]

Once a sanctuary for neo-humans, Angel Nest was established by the Crimson Angels as a beacon of hope. Its stunning yet perilous environment made it one of the most breathtaking colonies ever created, blending nature's beauty with ever-present danger. But its remote location and mysterious abandonment left it vulnerable to time and turmoil.

Rediscovered by Celtic Triquetra corporation, an attempt was made to revive the colony. However, relentless pirate attacks and unsustainable costs forced its desertion once again. Today, Angel Nest lies beyond corporate influence, its lush landscapes overshadowed by deadly flora, ferocious wildlife, and brutal pirate factions.

In Angelic: The Chaos Theatre, explore Angel Nest in its pre-pirate assault state, brought to life as part of hyper-realistic simulations designed to prepare neo-humans for the battles ahead. Play this iconic map in PvP and PvE modes, solo or with friends—for free!

Angelic🪽is a narrative strategy-RPG set in a dark, collaborative sci-fi universe. 

Endure as a team, or die alone!


[i](*) You read that right! We’re launching another alpha season to collect feedback and test exciting new features and ideas. Stay tuned—more details coming soon![/i]

notes.title: New Angels in the Making!
notes.content:
Angels🪽, the next 6 months will be GLORIOUS.

We’ve been cooking up exciting new features. Here’s a taste of what’s coming:

[previewyoutube=CPOaZuEMMxI;full][/previewyoutube]

🎮[b]Heroes:[/b]

Chun & Xue: The sibling duo with unique abilities and gripping backstories.

Shanwang: A synth longma, loyal guardian of the siblings, joining the fray.

Odile’s Black Swan: A dramatic, breathtaking upgrade to her iconic look.


👾[b]Units:[/b]

Infested Creatures: Terrifying, disgusting, and truly deadly (you’ll feel the fear).

Eugenic Commandos: Ruthless, elite hunters—barely human, engineered to kill.

Vivibot: A friendly synth (with a few loose screws) ready to spice up battles.


🎭[b]NPCs:[/b]

Ryoji Hoshinaga: Reputable captain from Hoshi Ryu with a hidden agenda.

Diana Lindberg: Clumsy, eccentric reporter streaming 24/7 with her flying cameras. She’s obsessed with neo-humans—especially the Goddess.

Sopdet: The Herald of the Mother and backbone of the Osiris ship. Mystical, awe-inspiring, and thankfully… friendly.

Nameless Ones: Silent, enigmatic sentinels of the Osiris ship. Don’t look into their third eye—you’ve been warned.


⚙️[b]Features & Upgrades[/b]

Overkill Blows: Deliver devastating, gory "overkill" attacks that behead or dismember your enemies. 

Osiris the Mothership: Your home in the Angelic universe! Talk with heroes, level them up, customize them, and trigger missions—all from the Osiris Mothership.

Hero Conversations: Engage with your heroes like never before—speak freely, even using your own voice, for endless, dynamic interactions that evolve as your journey unfolds!

Immersive Battles: Flying, jumping, climbing, and environmental interactions take the experience to the next level.

Hero Leveling: Unlock new skills, majestic alteration abilities, and tag-based combos for devastating effects.

The wait will be worth it.  Stay tuned!

notes.title: Open Alpha Season 2 is Live!
notes.content:
Dear Angels,

The wait is over! [b]Angelic: The Chaos Theatre Open Alpha Season 2 has officially launched.[/b] If you’ve previously downloaded the demo build, it’s ready and waiting in your library—simply update to the latest version and jump right into the action!

The Chaos awaits,

Glory to Angelic!

notes.title: Open Alpha Season 2 Starts on 7th of October
notes.content:
[b]Heads up, Angels,[/b]

We’re adjusting the launch date of Open Alpha Season 2 by one week. Initially set for September 30th, we're pushing it to [b]October 7th[/b]. This gives us extra time to polish things and ensure an amazing experience for both new and veteran players.

[previewyoutube=NFaH63z2XFo;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s New?Tempest Dam and Angel Nest maps have undergone significant revamps—you’re going to love the updates!

[list]
[*] The Hangar Bay tutorial map is also getting a makeover.
[*] The Forsaken Mine map will be temporarily disabled until we give it a fresh revamp.
[*] The Destructible Mesh System is nearly ready! Maps will now feature destructible objects, so tread carefully, Angels! Many things are fragile and can even explode unexpectedly. Watch out for AoE abilities! (*Daeva smiles mischievously)
[*] We’ve adjusted several gameplay mechanics. For instance, you’ll be able to walk and run more, but turns will be slightly shorter. Odile’s gravity manipulation now significantly slows movement, and Xander’s shockwave grenade EMP effect lasts for two turns, meaning invisible or camouflaged heroes will feel its effects longer.
[*] Fully functional leaderboards and leagues are coming!
[*] And of course, bazillions of UI-UX improvements.
[/list]

[b]Additional Notes:[/b]

We’re also working on adding [b]jumps and hard stops[/b] for heroes, making them more reactive to their environments. Jumps will help you quickly traverse small obstacles, and, for added flair, Seline can fly briefly while Odile glides at high speed. These features might not be available at the start of Season 2, but we’re hoping to include them before the season ends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/4667370c692fb782af7c145ab7a90b0156bccc89.png[/img]

New characters like [b]Cartel Commandos and Vivibot[/b], along with new heroes like [b]Chun and Xue[/b], are on the horizon and will be introduced in Open Alpha Season 3.

Full change list and details will be released with the new season. We apologize for the delay, but as perfectionists, we want to make sure everything’s just right. We’ll be working hard this week to ensure there are no further delays.

notes.title: Hotfix Update Notes - 20 August 2025
notes.content:
Hello Angels ,

We've rolled out a new update. Below are the detailed patch notes:

[b]Game Design Adjustments[/b]

*Seliné (Micro Angels Stance): Stance now lasts for 2 turns only. Revive ability cost increased to 7 AP (previously 2 AP) and has a 4 turn cooldown (previously 3 turns).
*Daeva (Void Storm) : Void Storm attack area reduced to 1500 cm (from 2000 cm) AND radius reduced to 4000 cm (from 5000 cm).
*Xander (Mirror the Pain): Now it lasts for 2 turns with a 0 cooldown. You can trigger it for free, similar to Seliné’s Micro Angels.
*Thundershark Control Consoles : Capture costs updated: 10 Energy (previously 22) and 9 AP (previously 5).

[b]Rank Point System Updates[/b]
Level Based Adjustments
*Removed penalties for level differences.
*Point allocation adjusted based on level differences:
+1 point for winning against players 3 levels below you.
+2 points for winning against players within ±3 levels.
+3 points for winning against players 4+ levels above you.

[b]Game Duration Multipliers[/b]
*Less then 5 minutes : No points.
*Less then 10 minutes : 0.75x multiplier.
*10-20 minutes: Full points (1x multiplier).
*More then 20 minutes   :1.25x multiplier

[b]League Based Modifiers[/b]
*Winning against higher league players: 50% bonus per league difference.
*Winning against lower league players: 20% deduction per league difference.
*Losing against higher league players: Additional 1 penalty.
*Losing against lower league players: Additional 0.5 penalty per league difference.

[b]AI Difficulty Settings[/b]
*Easy: No advantages, 4hero limit. Disabled for commanders level 10+.
*Normal: AI has 1 energy console, no deploy limit. No neutral units.
*Hard: AI has 1 energy console, various neutral units. Available only for commanders level 10+.
*Brutal: AI has all advantages from Hard mode, plus an additional energy console. Available only for commanders level 10+.

[b]Experience Points Mechanics[/b]
*XP Gains
*PvP: 30 XP per win.
*PvE: 5 XP (Easy), 10 XP (Normal), 20 XP (Hard), 35 XP (Brutal).
*Consecutive Wins: +5 XP per consecutive win (PvP only).
*Losers: 2 XP per killed hero, 1 XP per killed neutral unit.
*Tutorial Completion: 100 XP (one time reward).

[b]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b]
*Audio: New sounds for Tank and Big Gun explosions.
*Grenade Bug: Previously, if you clicked on a hero instead of an empty space when throwing Xander's grenade, the grenade would become useless later in the game. This issue has now been fixed, ensuring the grenade functions correctly regardless of where you click.
*UI Fixes: Improved ability to detail UI functionality.
*Stance Mechanics Clarification: We've received feedback about confusion regarding how to exit stances and manage posture abilities. A temporary solution has been added to the UI to help guide players. However, please note that this is a placeholder, and a detailed UI design for better stance and posture management will be included in the next update.
*Manipulate Gravity:Previously, running through the Manipulate Gravity area allowed players to regain all the APs lost after leaving the Manipulate Gravity zone, making the ability ineffective. This issue has been resolved now, AP will be consumed appropriately when you enter the Manipulate Gravity area, even if you attempt to leave and return.
*Camera Issues: Resolved camera focus problems near objects and raised platforms.
Steam API Integration: Steam players can now play multiplayer modes without needing an EOS account. However please note Steam and Epic Store players will no longer be seeing each other and can play against each other.
*Run to Benchmark" Functionality Previously, the "Run to Benchmark" feature automatically set graphics to Epic for all players. Now, it intelligently adjusts your graphics settings based on your PC's specifications to ensure optimal performance.

-*-

notes.title: Hotfix Update Notes (104)
notes.content:
Hello Angels ,

We've rolled out a new update packed with several important fixes and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Below are the detailed patch notes:

[b]XP Calculations:[/b]

[b]Consecutive Win Bonus Adjustments:[/b]

AI Battles: The consecutive win bonus for victories against AI opponents has been completely removed. This change ensures that XP gains remain fair and balanced across all game modes.

PvP Battles: The consecutive win bonus for victories against real players is now capped at 10 consecutive wins. This means the maximum bonus XP you can earn through this method is 50 XP (10 wins x 5 XP each). This cap ensures that XP rewards remain consistent and fair for all players.

Tutorial XP Reward: Completing the tutorial now grants a one-time bonus of 100 XP. This reward will no longer influence gameplay time, ensuring a smoother and more accurate progression experience.

[b]Negative Ranks Recovery:[/b]
 Players with negative ranks will now need to play and finish a PvP match to restore their rank to a positive level. 

[b]Tutorial Win Impact:[/b]

Previously, the tutorial was mistakenly counted as a win without affecting gameplay time. This issue has been addressed, and now the tutorial will only provide a one-time 100 XP bonus without impacting gameplay time. This ensures that tutorial completion is accurately reflected in your overall progress and prevents gaining the bonus XP repetitively, which was not an intended action.

[b]XP Bar Display:[/b]

[b]Updated XP Bar Values:[/b]

The values displayed next to the XP bar have been updated to show "Total XP collected (from Level 0) / Total XP required for next level (from Level 0)." This change provides clearer insight into your progress toward leveling up.

[b]AI Behavior Fixes[/b]

[b]AI Xander Attack Fix:[/b]

AI Xander has been adjusted to behave more strategically during battles. After executing his regular attack, AI Xander will now correctly wait until the end of his turn before taking further action.

[b]UI & UX Improvements:[/b]

[b]Enemy Neutral Units Damage UI Color:[/b]

We have fixed the UI color issue where damage from enemy neutral units was displayed as if it were from your own ally units. This caused some confusion, which should now be resolved, making it easier to distinguish between ally and enemy actions.

[b]Camera Stuck in Tactical Mode:[/b]

A potential fix has been implemented to address the issue where the camera could get stuck in Tactical mode during the roaming phase.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[b]AI Captain Deployment Issue:[/b]

* We've fixed a bug where the AI would sometimes deploy no captain or the wrong captain. Although players were not generally aware of this issue, it has been resolved on our side to ensure proper AI behavior in matches.
* A critical localization issue preventing Cyrillic and other alphabets from appearing correctly in-game has been fixed.
* We've addressed and resolved certain crashes that occurred during the logout process, improving overall game stability.
* We have fixed the issue where, after defeating the tank, it would go underground and cause the game to crash. Players can now continue playing the game as intended without encountering this problem.

notes.title: Angelic: The Chaos Theatre Open Alpha Coming to Steam for a Limited Time!
notes.content:
Exciting news, Angels! We are on the brink of releasing a new build packed with improvements and thrilling new features. This build holds special significance as it marks our first-ever Open Alpha release.

While we initially aimed to catch Steam Next Fest for the Open Alpha release, our commitment to perfection means we are taking a bit more time to ensure everything is just right.

Let’s dive into what’s coming with the new build!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/ebd2ee66c93994cd090d39456a72e634e9ddc956.jpg[/img]
[i]Daeva with her Night Succubus skin (unreleased)[/i]

[h2]Optimization[/h2]

We know optimization was one of the biggest issues we faced in the past. The good news is that we’ve managed to significantly optimize the game. While optimization is an ongoing process and we aren’t claiming the game is in a perfect state, our new demo will be substantially more performant than the previous live build.

Our minimum spec is now Nvidia GTX 1060, achieving 30+ FPS at 1080p resolution, even with Lumen on. Depending on your PC configuration, you might see a 200–250% FPS increase with the next update!

Even better, if you have an Nvidia GPU with RTX cores, enabling DLSS will boost your FPS further.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/ecec294e46466911cbfc942853f5b7be3c045881.gif[/img]
[i]Phoenix using his pulse rifle, Hydra, to eliminate Seliné[/i]


[h2]Play Against AI![/h2]

The first iteration of our PvE game modes featuring single-player and co-op against AI is also coming with the next build. You no longer need to wait for other players to play Angelic. Even better, now you can team up with your friends against AI.

Our AI will continuously improve and have deep learning abilities, meaning it will learn, adapt, and improve over time. Initially, though, expect an AI that is challenging but not perfect.

Please keep in mind PvE game modes have different rules than standard PvP Raid game modes:

[list]
[*] AI player(s) will always be defenders.
[*] Domination victory type is disabled, so you need to either capture Thundershark or annihilate AI teams before the time runs out.
[*] Tactical victory is also disabled, so if you cannot defeat AI before the turn limit hits, you lose.
[*] Satellite dishes are also disabled, meaning you cannot capture the enemy team’s satellite dish to temporarily disable their hero deployment.
[*] AI team will start by owning 2 out of 3 energy stations, plus some units (including Anzu Tank in Tempest Dam and Cloud Defender gun in Angel Nest maps).
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/846f3c8cd8c18ef71d79b9a0b3eff745840941f7.gif[/img]
[i]Select Play against AI from the Game Mode menu. Play alone (1vE) or co-op with your friends (2vE)![/i]

It’s already fun to play against AI, and just wait until our deep learning AI gets ready — it will be quite hard to defeat then! (We will lower some of the current advantages provided to AI in the future.)

[h2]Player Progression, Hero Unlocking and Starter Pack Heroes[/h2]

We now have a player progression mechanism that lets you level up and obtain rewards, the most important being the ability to unlock new heroes. During the closed beta cycles, all heroes were enabled for testing purposes. However, starting with the entire roster can be confusing and overwhelming for new players. Now you will start with Phoenix (Commando), Xander (Tank), and Seliné (Support/Supermedic).

You will have one initial hero unlock. You can unlock any hero, and afterwards, you need to level up and obtain “angel shards.” When you combine 4 shards, you get one hero unlock.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/1cde161b066438d6b863c55996c137079f72a43e.jpg[/img]
[i]Unlocking Seliné Vivarri[/i]

Please note we will also implement a hero leveling mechanism, allowing your heroes to level up and gain additional skills and abilities. This feature will arrive at a later date.

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]

One of the most demanded features: a combat tutorial. We implemented a sandbox tutorial mode that teaches you the basics of combat without boring you and lets you test every hero freely, even if you haven’t unlocked them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/90bc98419e88069ecc3fd8c4b8658617c6461a2c.gif[/img]
[i]Aurora activated the drone in the Forsaken Mine to remove an obstacle from her path.[/i]

[h2]Angelverse Account System Overhaul[/h2]

We are moving Angelverse accounts to another infrastructure so players from China can also access the game. We will be adding new features like website sync and fixing known issues like games not being registered to your accounts, etc.

[h2]How to Access the New Build and When It’s Coming Out[/h2]

We are hoping to catch Steam Next Fest, but if we can’t make it, a possible delay won’t be too long. Expect the new build to be playable in a couple of weeks!

We are planning to organize tournaments to celebrate the new build and might make it available for everyone for a limited time. This will essentially be our first public launch, with details to be announced later. Please keep in mind that for the full open beta, we are still aiming for mid-August, if not later.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/aff39204b92e320b03c97650ce15e6999407aa5d.jpg[/img]
Wishlist us on http://bit.ly/AngelicSteam & http://bit.ly/AngelicEpic


Your feedback and support have been invaluable in shaping Angelic, and we can’t wait to continue this journey together. Keep an eye out for more updates as we approach the Open Beta.

Thank you for being a part of our community. See you in the next update, Angels!

Erkan Bayol

Founder and CEO at Metaverse Game Studios
Game Director of Angelic

notes.title: Exploring The Chaos Theatre: A Tactical Multiplayer Module in Angelic
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/49461829aec55bf0134f5fe511c97687c5886100.png[/img]

[h2]Angels in Training[/h2]

We are drawing closer to the closed beta launch of The Chaos Theatre, a free tactical multiplayer module for Angelic. Like the base game, The Chaos Theatre is also a strategy-RPG set in a dark and collaborative sci-fi universe. Iset, the Mother, tasked Phoenix and his crew with traveling to a special place: a military training station known as The Chaos Theatre, where angels test their skills in ultra-realistic combat simulations.

Space is full of terror and tragedy, yet you must explore it. However, first, you need to prepare for what is to come. This is why the Chaos Theatre will serve as an excellent starting point for your journey in the dark and unforgiving universe of Angelic.

Visit Historic Battle Scenes, Utilize Your Environment, and Pursue Different Victory Types in the Raid Game Mode!

We have been busy implementing a new game mode called “Raid,” while also crafting three battlegrounds inspired by significant historic events in the lore.

Furthermore, we have introduced 2v2 team play and an advanced version of free-for-all modes!

Now, let’s delve into the raid mode. Players will be divided into two teams: Assaulters and Defenders. The primary objective will be capturing the Thundershark dropship (or defending it).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/e4dea5b6256cec4afe0c748ad1add775bf5e8c47.gif[/img]
[i]Xander stands guard by the dropship Thundershark. Battlefield: Angel Nest.[/i]

When the battle commences, each player selects a “captain.” The game will then initiate in real-time mode. You will have the freedom to roam and attempt to capture strategic locations or position your heroes in tactical zones. We refer to this initial phase as the “captain roaming phase.” Use it wisely, as it will conclude swiftly, and it can end even earlier if enemy heroes encounter each other before the time limit.

Once the captain roam phase concludes, the deployment phase begins. You can deploy additional heroes during deployment turns; however, be mindful of your energy resources, as they are crucial and limited. Currently, each hero deployment costs 30 energy, and you can generate only 5 energy per combat turn (meaning all heroes play once before another deployment turn begins). You can also gain 10 energy by eliminating enemy heroes. Nevertheless, the most reliable source of energy is capturing an energy station. We will discuss stations in more detail shortly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/a6e8a383e80c49fde8a82156d31f788061e39192.gif[/img]
[i]Aurora explores in the captain roaming phase, sprinting to secure a nearby neo-human clone before the battle commences.[/i]

[h2]Victory Types[/h2]

If the assault team can capture the Thundershark, they will achieve an “assault victory.” Defenders, on the other hand, need to endure while preventing attackers from capturing the ship until the end of the match (yes, there is a turn limit, a maximum time, for each game now). Should they accomplish this, they secure a “tactical victory.”

There are two additional victory types: “Annihilation victory,” signifying the elimination of all heroes on the enemy team, and “Domination victory,” indicating the capture of enough victory points.

Victory points can be obtained by capturing points of interest on the map. This leads us to another major feature we have implemented: Stations!

[h2]Stations[/h2]

Several stations on the map can be captured by expending a certain amount of action points and energy. Remember, energy is a very scarce resource, which is also needed to deploy new heroes. Every decision has consequences!

Stations provide one victory point when captured, but that’s not all. Stations also offer additional benefits. Some provide new units like neo-human clones or synths, while others can even grant you a massive tank or AA gun to control! Some stations start generating energy for you. There are special stations that control Thundershark’s access, and the stations inside Thundershark’s cockpit area are the ones attackers need to capture in order to achieve the assault victory (so if you are a defender, protect them at all costs!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/b70150809158743ae33dc4fdbd98d60af5d7b2d2.gif[/img]
[i]Aurora seizes control of a console. In addition to the victory point, this station grants control over a nearby neo-human clone![/i]

[h2]Environment and Zone Control[/h2]

Remember, Angelic is not only an RPG, but also a strategy game. All heroes are quite distinct with their unique abilities and varying strengths and weaknesses.

What further complicates the combat is the factor of drop pods. Pods are not just vessels for heroes to arrive on the battlefield; they also provide numerous bonuses. Using them wisely is crucial. For example, Xander’s pod can repair your armor, while Daeva’s pod can damage nearby enemy shields while regenerating yours, and Seliné’s pod can provide bonus healing to her, whereas Aurora’s pod is essential for triggering her deadly Overwatch ability, which grants her a massive zone control power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/d59e9397321813e020d8f135fdb1ff2a23018a63.gif[/img]
[i]Rumbrogon strategically relocates his pod to a nearby spot, securing bonus regeneration in its proximity.[/i]

While utilizing pods, you must also consider the environment. Capturing and defending strategic stations can turn the tide of the battle, while redeploying your pods strategically to continue benefiting from their bonuses might save the day as well. Simultaneously, keep an eye on your satellite dishes; if the enemy can hack them, you can no longer deploy additional heroes, even if you have the energy for it.

[h2]Even More Variety is Coming![/h2]

Have you seen our heroes’ epic-looking skins? Well, know that these are not just cosmetic variations. Each hero skin brings different abilities, slightly altering the base hero. For instance, Phoenix’s “Revenant” skin has “firestorm” as a super ability, burning everybody around him, while his “Last Born” skin has “Combustion” instead, focusing on a  single target, engulfing them in flames and applying continuous damage for multiple turns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/42e3e2680b0e5b31a9db421d2bdacfc102c5d062.png[/img]
[i]“Concept sketches for Aurora’s Dark Specter skin. All designs are stunning! (Please note that these are preliminary exploration sketches, not finalized concepts)[/i]

We will discuss hero variants and skins in more detail later.

[h2]Next Topic: Battlefields![/h2]

Our next blog post will introduce our battlefields: Angel Nest, Tempest Dam, and Forsaken Mine.

Stay tuned!

notes.title: Angelic's Steam Store Page Gets a Major Overhaul
notes.content:
Greetings, all transcended and old ones!

The Steam store page for Angelic has just undergone a major overhaul. All screenshots, visuals, and game descriptions have been updated. We have also released a new gameplay teaser.

Please note that the single-player campaign for Angelic is still under development. We are now officially calling the narrative version of the game "Angelic: Dark Symphony." We will launch another Steam store page for the upcoming base game at a later date.

The existing store page now belongs to Angelic: The Chaos Theatre. Both games are strategy-RPGs set in our dark and collaborative sci-fi universe. The Chaos Theatre is primarily a multiplayer game that is free to play, while Dark Symphony will be a narrative, single-player game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/b8ed95734bf40226fb6087393fffe681678c1053.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more exciting announcements! We will be attending multiple Steam events and have lots of exciting news to share.

We will meet soon in the simulated battle arenas of the Chaos Theatre.

Until then, may the Goddess watch over you, commander.

notes.title: Angelic: The Chaos Theatre Coming to Steam Soon!
notes.content:
Angelic: The Chaos Theatre, a free multiplayer PvP module of the upcoming base game, is coming to Steam soon.

For years we have been working on Angelic: Dark Symphony, a narrative strategy-RPG set in a dark and collaborative universe. notes.title: Complaints About Hero Designs Potentially Seen as Sexist
notes.content:
We received complaints about the design of heroes being potentially seen as sexist, especially Daeva...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/4c5bee871ff21149ebab739e4742f16e7cd4a66c.png[/img]

Daeva is surely a sexy character, but her main power is about manipulating your desires. Please check her design details here: https://youtu.be/afQlffKzZBA

In general, if you watch the 3rd, 4th and 5th vlogs released by us, you will realize nothing is really simple about our heroes. They have all deep and sophisticated personalities, and fascinating back stories waiting to be discovered by you! 

We always listen to our players' feedback, getting feedback was one of the key reasons why we have released the early stage demo. 

Also remember, you will be able to customize your heroes so if you don't like their default look, no worries! There will be plenty of options!

notes.title: About Phoenix's Design and Hero Customizations
notes.content:
One of the common bits of feedback we received in our demo was about Phoenix, the main character. 

Roughly half of the testers did not like the design. Good news is, he will be quite customizable, and we are considering adding a female version. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40331662/ba5faa7d31a7a0adbda3693c01a8a4ff314e8281.png[/img]

Our resources were quite limited during the demo production, as you know. That's why we were not able to add much customization options to our heroes. 

However, in the full version, there will be plenty of options to customize Phoenix and the rest of the crew!
